title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Providing Green Graduation Opportunities to Households Living in Conditions of Extreme Poverty in Tanganyika Province, DRC programme will work in Manono, Kabalo and Kongolo, Democratic Republic of Congo. It aims to contribute to Concern DRC’s Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to graduate vulnerable households out of conditions of extreme poverty and support communities to be more inclusive and resilient in Tanganyika, with emphasis placed on improved environmental protection and sustainability. The programme will support over 147,960 people living in extreme poor households, including female headed households, households with disabled members, households with pregnant and lactating women. This will be done through households having access to a predictable source of income to cover their basic needs, households receive farmer field schools trainings, households receive life skills and literacy training, gender transformative discussions held for beneficiaries and partners and improved social cohesion in target communities .. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: To graduate vulnerable households out of conditions of extreme poverty and support communities to be more inclusive and resilient in Tanganyika, with emphasis placed on improved environmental protection and sustainability . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: RM Adaptation 2: Climate smart agriculture is fundamental to the purpose of this outcome and is an eligible area of work for Rio Marker scoring of two. DRR 1: HH resilience to shocks and disasters through the promotion of sustainable livelihoods and training for HHs on micro-business development, family and business planning, risk management, and sustainability. Aid to Environment 1: Concern’s Green Graduation programme added a 5th pillar to the traditional graduation model - the ‘green’ aspect which aims to improve environmental protection and stability through awareness raising, capacity building, assessing environmental impacts, reducing and managing environmental risks and increasing natural assets.Capacity Building 1: HH capacity is strengthened throug training for HHs on micro-business development, family and business planning, risk management, and sustainability. Gender Equality 1: a gender lens is applied at every stage and a gender transformative approach is taken to tackle harmful gender norms, attitudes and practices. Nutrition 1: Through increased food security and messaging on nutrition, the nutritional status of HHs is improved.
